summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from New York on the aftermath of John Dwyer's win over Elliott, adding that Tom Allen was expected to dispute Dwyer's title, having been sent letters guaranteeing him $1,000 stakes and expenses.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, May 12, 1879, page 7. Dispatch dated New York, May 11.

facts.fact: Allen was expected to dispute John Dwyer's claim to the championship, letters having been sent to him guaranteeing $1,000 for stakes and his expenses

notes: The paper names Dwyer's opponent 'Jos. Elliott' (Jimmy Elliott); it adds that Dwyer was not thought likely to fight again.
